evaluate_boxes: run PASCAL VOC object detection evaluation on a dataset using predicted bounding boxes and compute mean AP
write_voc_results_files: create VOC-format result files from predicted bounding boxes for each class in the dataset
get_voc_results_file_template: build the file path template for VOC detection results under the devkit results directory
do_python_eval: run the unofficial Python PASCAL VOC evaluation code to compute AP, precision, and recall per class
voc_info: extract year, image set, devkit path, annotation path, and image set path from a VOC dataset name
